# Configuration

Environment variables read by the API, or `apps/api/.env`. Durations use ISO 8601, e.g. `P14D`.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `FH_ENVIRONMENT` | `development` | Deployment environment. Controls docs exposure and other safety switches. |
| `FH_DATABASE_URL` | `postgresql+asyncpg://family_hub:family_hub@localhost:5432/family_hub` | SQLAlchemy URL for PostgreSQL, using the asyncpg driver. |
| `FH_REDIS_URL` | `redis://localhost:6379/0` | Redis URL for rate limits and other ephemeral state. |
| `FH_SECRET_KEY` | *(insecure dev value; required in production)* | Key for deriving CSRF tokens. Must be set to a long random value in production. |
| `FH_COOKIE_SECURE` | `true` | Mark cookies `Secure` and use the `__Host-` prefix. Disable only for plain-HTTP dev. |
| `FH_SESSION_IDLE_TIMEOUT` | `P14D` | A session unused for this long expires (AUTH-6). |
| `FH_SESSION_ABSOLUTE_TIMEOUT` | `P60D` | A session expires this long after login, regardless of use (AUTH-6). |
